_doc: Talent trees (TalentManager.gd, docs/design/TALENTS.md). 1 point per level from first_point_level; a tier-T node needs tier_points[T-1] points spent in its branch; nodes with 'skill' unlock that skill; effects are per rank. Forks: nodes sharing a 'choice' id in a branch are mutually exclusive (mut2 = mutate the tier-2 skill, t4 = the tier-4 passive, mut5 = mutate the ultimate); 'requires' names a node in the branch that must be learned first; fork_alt marks the second tier-4 option.
